title: New funding to build towards AGI
reason: $40B raise at a $300B valuation is a historic, market-moving funding round for a frontier lab.

sources.summary: Today we’re announcing new funding—$40B at a $300B post-money valuation, which enables us to push the frontiers of AI research even further, scale our compute infrastructure, and deliver increasingly powerful tools for the 500 million people who use ChatGPT every week.

title: Stargate advances with 4.5 GW partnership with Oracle
reason: A 4.5 GW Stargate expansion with Oracle is a major, named infrastructure commitment with significant compute-market implications.

sources.summary: Oracle and OpenAI have entered an agreement to develop 4.5 gigawatts of additional Stargate data center capacity in the U.S. This investment will create new jobs, accelerate America’s reindustrialization, and help advance U.S. AI leadership. It also marks a major milestone for Stargate, OpenAI’s AI infrastructure platform and long-term vision to deliver the benefits of AI to everyone.
